description: Fetch specific AppSumo deals, search the catalogue, browse categories or collections, or filter the lifetime-deal archive.

category.description: Optional AppSumo category slug, for example email-sms-marketing or calendar-scheduling. Used for catalogue browsing and combined with search queries.
category.title: Category

collection.description: Browse a curated AppSumo collection. Leave empty to skip collection browsing.
collection.title: Collection

dealStatus.description: Current live deals, the full all-time archive, or expired deals only.
dealStatus.title: Deal status

dealType.description: Filter by the type of deal AppSumo lists.
dealType.title: Deal type

dealUrls.description: Optional AppSumo product URLs, product paths or bare slugs, for example https://appsumo.com/products/tidycal/, /products/tidycal/ or tidycal. Numeric deal IDs are also accepted. The Console form prefills one TidyCal URL; API runs only fetch deals you send here.
dealUrls.title: Deal URLs or IDs

group.description: Filter the catalogue by AppSumo category group.
group.title: Category group

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted AppSumo deals.
maxItems.title: Max deals

maxReviewsPerDeal.description: Review cap per deal when reviews are enabled. Every review of a deal is reachable.
maxReviewsPerDeal.title: Max reviews per deal

scrapeDetails.description: Fetch each deal page for plans, features, FAQs, taxonomy and lifecycle data. Turn off for faster card-only browsing.
scrapeDetails.title: Fetch full deal details

scrapeReviews.description: Add individual customer reviews from the public AppSumo reviews API.
scrapeReviews.title: Fetch reviews

searchPages.description: How many result pages to scan for each search query, catalogue filter or collection.
searchPages.title: Pages per query or filter

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search in the AppSumo catalogue, for example calendar, crm or seo. Each query is scanned for searchPages pages.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: Order of the emitted deals. Rating, ending-soon and price orders use AppSumo's own sorting; newest and most-reviewed are sorted deterministically after fetching the requested pages.
sortBy.title: Sort order

subcategory.description: Optional AppSumo subcategory slug, for example scheduling-bookings or seo.
subcategory.title: Subcategory

useProxy.description: Route requests through Apify proxy. AppSumo serves direct requests reliably, so this is off by default; the actor also retries through the automatic Apify proxy if a block is detected.
useProxy.title: Use Apify proxy

title: AppSumo Lifetime Deal Input
